environment.execution: single Node.js event loop; no provider or database connection

fixture.construction: Generate one valid receipt with the real tool implementation; clone its independently replayable content with a distinct host receipt UUID for each request.
fixture.baseline_snapshot_profile: The reviewFixture helper gives each synthetic record a distinct parse snapshot ID.
fixture.async_snapshot_profile: All synthetic records use one shared parse snapshot ID, matching a single parsed source material. This differs from the baseline profile, so these measurements demonstrate timer starvation and yielding rather than an identical-fixture speed comparison.

baseline.source_note: Measured using m3-linked-runtime-20261004 compiled review-tools, whose source matches current develop after line-ending normalization. Its older single-reference evidence validator is not invoked by this empty-observation, empty-coverage fixture.

verification.skip_reason: The PostgreSQL durable Codex test did not have a test database configured.

final_targeted_tests.note: Final API/worker build with cancellation repair and web-evidence lock ordering; includes review-model-stage, citations, tools, async replay, cancellation, codex-adapter and provider-result-validation tests.

guards: All receipts and source bindings are independently replayed on each call.
Timers run between receipts; yielding is not limited to Promise microtasks.
Source or trace mutations during yielding are rejected by final content hashes.
Cancellation prevents a trusted trace or envelope from being returned.

limitations: This is a synthetic reproduction of worker event-loop starvation, not a confirmation of the cause of the user's production run.
No authenticated production task, provider process, real material, report delivery or database lease was exercised in these measurements.

Separate unverified static risk: the Codex adapter limits cumulative stdout to 4 MiB. If the production CLI includes read_records MCP results in JSON events, lengthy legitimate tool output may reach that limit. The existing fake tool fixture omits completed-item result bodies. This change does not increase the limit or claim that risk is confirmed.
